description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerApproval class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Customer namespace. It provides methods for managing customer approval records, including retrieving, deleting, approving, and denying customer approval requests and related entities.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling customer approval-related database operations such as retrieving, deleting, approving, and denying approvals.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes all approval records for a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approval records based on filter criteria provided in the data array.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Fetches a single customer approval record by its approval ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Counts the total number of customer approvals matching specified filter criteria.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Approves a customer by updating their status and removing approval records.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Denies a customer by removing their approval record.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Approves an affiliate by updating their status and managing approval records.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Denies an affiliate by removing their approval record.
